nodes.label: Lapidary Working Rules
nodes.rationale: The canonical rule set. Encodes decisions expensive to reverse so agents read them before writing code in an area.

nodes.label: We Never Edit Geometry
nodes.rationale: Editing belongs to Rhino, Fusion, FreeCAD, Blender, Orca. Lapidary visualizes, measures, routes and versions; competing with a CAD kernel's editor is unwinnable for a solo project.

nodes.label: Never Delete User Data Implicitly
nodes.rationale: Delete is soft, purge is separate and explicit, blobs quarantine 30 days. Derivative cache eviction must never read as data loss, because a user who fears for their models has lost trust in the product.

nodes.label: Automatic Format Negotiation
nodes.rationale: Slicers get 3MF/STL, CAD gets STEP, the viewer gets glTF. Never hand a mesh to someone who needed B-rep.

nodes.label: Measurement Must Not Lie
nodes.rationale: Analytic values come from B-rep entities where available; mesh-derived numbers are labelled approximate in the UI, always, so a tessellated figure is never mistaken for a nominal one.

nodes.label: Versioning Is Perforce-Shaped, Not Git-Shaped
nodes.rationale: Three-way merge is undefined for a B-rep solid and textual diff is meaningless, so: immutable content-addressed snapshots, a lineage DAG, pessimistic locks, and geometric diff in place of textual diff.

nodes.label: Governance Is Opt-In Per Library
nodes.rationale: Hobby libraries have no revisions, states or approvals; flipping a library to controlled turns that machinery on. One architecture serves hobbyist STLs and industrial STEP assemblies.

nodes.label: The Application Is Free And Complete
nodes.rationale: No gated features in the app. Revenue comes from the server, fleet, support and cloud, which is why lapidary-api may never depend on lapidary-enterprise.

nodes.label: Downloads Are Never Silently Converted
nodes.rationale: variant=original returns byte-identical ingested bytes; anything we produced is named *.lapidary.*, so a user always knows whether they hold their own file or ours.

nodes.label: Container-First Distribution
nodes.rationale: Podman and Docker. The Tauri app is a later phase and bundles only our own binaries, never Postgres and never OCCT, which removes the highest-risk bundling item from the plan.

nodes.label: No SQL Outside lapidary-db
nodes.rationale: Everything goes through repository traits, enforced by deny.toml wrappers rather than review, so SQL cannot leak into feature crates.

nodes.label: The Open Path Never Touches A Source File Or The Kernel
nodes.rationale: Opening a part reads metadata plus derivatives only. Parsing STEP on open is the failure mode this rule exists to forbid; it is what keeps first paint under 120 ms.

nodes.label: Hash First, Always
nodes.rationale: BLAKE3 before anything else in ingest; a known hash short-circuits the whole pipeline, which is what makes re-import feel free.

nodes.label: Generated Columns Are Explicitly STORED
nodes.rationale: PG 18 defaults generated columns to virtual, and virtual columns cannot be indexed, so the tsvector search column would silently lose its GIN index.

nodes.label: Content Addressing Is Not Authorization
nodes.rationale: Hashes leak into manifests, logs, bundles and support tickets. Knowing a blob hash must never be a capability; always check tenant plus part reachability.

nodes.label: Pin Everything
nodes.rationale: Exact image digests, Cargo.lock committed, GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs because tags are mutable and that mutability is actively exploited.

nodes.label: lapidary-api Is A Library That Builds A Router
nodes.rationale: One codebase, three artifacts, all thin shells over the same axum Router. Never a binary, never forked per distribution.

nodes.label: Prefer The Boring Option
nodes.rationale: Solo-maintained and destined for air-gapped industrial environments: fewer dependencies, fewer moving parts, more explicit failure modes.

nodes.label: Mechanical Motion, Dark Only
nodes.rationale: Dark only with no light mode; 120/180/280ms on cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), transform and opacity only, prefers-reduced-motion respected.

nodes.label: No Bare User-Facing Strings In Components
nodes.rationale: Every string goes through src/lib/strings.ts. English only today, but Turkish is the planned second locale and retrofitting extraction later is far more expensive.

nodes.label: Real Content In Examples And Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Plausible part numbers and real dimensions, never 'Part 1 / Part 2' — placeholder fixtures hide the layout and search problems real names cause.

nodes.label: Errors Say What Broke And What To Do
nodes.rationale: thiserror in libraries, anyhow at binary edges, no unwrap() outside tests, and a message naming the remedy rather than 'parse failed (3)'.
